svg.aria-label: What it does. Reads receipts: 91 of 91 totals right on a test set it never saw. It started at 51. Finds the document: 83% of the right documents come up in the first ten results. Tracks the crew van: Every house visit logged from GPS, with history back to 2019. Closes the books: Four separate sets of books. The owner report tied out to the cent.
